posts.cooked: Had a really fun game tonight with the kids. The line up was Ambuscade, La Capiton, and Plague Rat vs Grandpa Legacy, Santa Guise and Omnitron X in Magmaria. Loved the way the environment played, but the interaction between the heroes was the best. No body could leave the table as at any given time we were all acting on each other's turns either putting cards into play or using powers. It was great fun. The Villians  were outstanding as well, great flavor and fun to fight.

posts.cooked: I've now played more Vengeance games with the new expansion they I did with any Vengeance combination, that's how much more engaging it is.  Even we get a drawn out vise of death (La Capitan/Operative/HammerAnvil/Ambuscade) where the monkey had 12 cards underneath him by the second round, it's still very intersting.  One thing I have found is that the is often a debate over who the priority target should be, which means that the designs really worked at not making some obvious choices and some you could ignore.

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
I'm with the masses in the newfound enjoyment of Vengeance style play. These new villains are all interesting and more centrally focused. Even with their disparate approach to the fight, the villain combos manage to help each other just enough to keep things interesting and the focus of attack not as clear as it can sometimes be with the Vengeance Five.

 

One perk of being engaged is that I can forcibly make my partner play Sentinels with me, and over the past two weekends we knocked out each Villains villain once (and he's grown quite attached to Mr Fixer) with only one loss due to an overzealous KNYFE. It was great fun seeing Proletariet gaining some teeth even with the assistance of Citizens Anvil and Hammer and Miss Information!

 

Anyway, good times ahead for me, as I don't sigh inwardly when the table sways towards Vengeance style fights. Though, admittedly, it rarely, if ever, did before now.

posts.name: waedens
posts.cooked:
Just had a great game. The matchup was:

America's Greatest Legacy vs. Proletariat 

Santa Guise vs. Friction

Omnitron X xs. Biomancer 

Knyfe Rogue Agent vs. Bugbear

in the Court of Blood

Too many great things happened to detail it all. Suffice it to say the Vengeance format is super fun. All it was lacking in the past was enough villains to give it the variety it needed to keep from being too repetitive. I would totally be up for another Villains style expansion.  I know that there are quite a few projects ahead in the line, but I will keep my fingers crossed that the future will hold at least a few more villains for this format.
